sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No. 5269 Of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.204 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kavali II Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 272, 273 IPC and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Kavali II Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: When the matter came up for hearing, learned counsel for the petitioner has placed reliance on the order dated 21.07.2020 passed in Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020 by this Court.
In view of the aforesaid, it is urged that the FIR may be quashed against the petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor did not oppose the said submission.

Considering the submissions and in view of the fact this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the criminal petition is allowed and proceedings in Crime No.204 of 2020 on the file of the Station House Officer, Kavali II Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District, against the petitioner,
are hereby quashed; consequently no further action is necessary in the facts of the case.

entities.text: Kavali II Town Police Station, SPSR Nellore District

sentences.text: Miscellaneous applications pending if any, shall stand closed.
